name: codex-image-grid
description: Native macOS image generation and editing for Codex. Supports Prompt Batch, reference-character generation, partial edits, thumbnails, and project/article/video visuals through codex_image_grid/generate_image_grid.

interface.shortDescription: Native image generation, editing, and Prompt Batch for Codex
interface.longDescription: The public Codex Image Grid route for image generation, editing, Prompt Batch, thumbnails, and project/article/video visuals. Use generate for new images and reference-character variations, or edit to change a supplied image while preserving other details. It exposes codex_image_grid/generate_image_grid through MCP, opens the native SwiftUI app, accepts local source/reference images, and returns job status, manifest, handoff, image paths, and Codex Markdown for CodexVideo and RelayPress. The separate retired Electron project is not a runtime fallback.
defaultPrompt: Generate new images or edit the supplied image with Codex Image Grid
Create a Prompt Batch of thumbnails for this project
Create article or video visuals with Codex Image Grid
